blocks.text: KING OF JUDAH · TWO KINGDOMS
Jehoahaz. Three months in Jerusalem, then a prisoner of Egypt.
REIGNEDi
3 months c. 609 BC (dates vary)
CAPITAL
Jerusalem
HOUSE
House of David 17th of 20 in Judah
VERDICT
✕ Did evil “And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.”
PROPHETS
Jeremiah
JUDAH (THE SOUTH): 20 RULERS REHOBOAM → ZEDEKIAH
THE ANOINTING
How Jehoahaz was anointed
"The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father's stead." 2 Kings 23:30 2 Chronicles 36:1
From the textHe was twenty-three; his brother Jehoiakim, who followed him, was twenty-five. The people passed over an older son. 2 Kings 23:31 2 Kings 23:36
SUCCESSION
The two kingdoms
THE VERDICT
How Scripture judges the reign
“And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, according to all that his fathers had done.”
2 Kings 23:32 (KJV) →

Chronicles gives him no verdict. 2 Chronicles 36:1–4

IN SCRIPTURE
Every passage
CHAPTERS · 5
2 Kings 23 2 Chronicles 36 1 Chronicles 3 Jeremiah 22 Ezekiel 19
PASSAGES · 5
2 Kings 23:30–34 2 Chronicles 36:1–4 1 Chronicles 3:15 Jeremiah 22:10–12 Ezekiel 19:1–4
WHAT SCRIPTURE DOES NOT SAY
Scripture does not say why the people chose him over his older brother.
Scripture does not say how long he lived in Egypt.
IDENTIFICATIONS THIS PAGE RELIES ON

From the textJeremiah speaks of "Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father", who went away and would die where he was taken. That fits Jehoahaz, taken to Egypt; this page therefore joins the site's separate record for Shallum son of Josiah (1 Chr 3:15) to this king. Jeremiah 22:11–12 1 Chronicles 3:15 2 Kings 23:34

From the textThe site's person data also lists "Johanan" (Josiah's firstborn, 1 Chr 3:15) as another name for Jehoahaz, and gives the name "Shallum" to Jehoiachin. This page follows neither: Scripture does not equate Johanan with Jehoahaz, and Jeremiah's Shallum is the son who reigned instead of Josiah. 1 Chronicles 3:15 Jeremiah 22:11
